faq.a: The formatter works on standard SQL structure (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, joins, subqueries) and is dialect-neutral — it formats layout and keyword case without parsing vendor-specific syntax.
No. It only adjusts whitespace, line breaks, and keyword capitalization. String literals, quoted identifiers, and comments are preserved exactly.
faq.q: Does it change my query's meaning?

heroSubtitle: Turn a cramped one-line query into a readable, consistently formatted statement.
metaDescription: Format SQL queries instantly: uppercase keywords, clause-per-line layout and clean indentation. Free online SQL beautifier, runs in your browser.
title: SQL Formatter — Free Online Tool | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: It is a layout formatter, not a parser — exotic vendor syntax or malformed SQL may come out imperfectly aligned, so eyeball critical queries before running them.
It cannot optimize or lint your SQL; for execution plans and index advice you need your database's own tooling.
